plan.failureSummary: The test failed because the chatbot backend API (https://briefcase.chat/api/chat) returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when processing chat messages, preventing the application from generating responses.
observedIndicators: Browser logs show HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses for calls to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat
Chatbot UI renders only a single letter 'A' or hangs without delivering an AI response
Page AI runner reported 'Objective not completable' due to chatbot backend failure

remediationSteps.summary: Fix backend HTTP 500 errors on /api/chat endpoint
remediationSteps.details: Investigate and resolve backend exceptions on https://briefcase.chat/api/chat. Ensure LLM API keys and backend model connections are properly configured and operating correctly.

plan.notes: The test script and AI prompt are functioning properly. The root cause is an upstream application defect in the briefcase.chat backend service.
